name: CIBA Approval Sequence LAB
description: API collection for CIBA Approval Sequence LAB: the lab's read surface (talk track, approval-sequence diagram) plus the Mock/Real toggle and its unconfigured refusal. The sequence itself is rendered from data; the lab's mock lane is a labelled simulation.

folders.name: Sanity (mock, labelled)
folders.description: Health and mode info (mock by default; Real is owner-run).

folders.name: Story data
folders.description: The talk track and the approval-sequence diagram the page renders.

folders.name: Mode toggle
folders.description: The Mock/Real toggle. Real needs owner-run settings (REAL_CIBA_*); without them it answers 409 with what is missing — that refusal is the negative case here.

requests.name: Switch to Real without settings (negative, 409 with detail)
